quote.text: In every walk with nature, one receives far more than he seeks.
quote.author: John Muir

fun_fact.text: Hungarian paprika comes in eight different varieties, ranging from sweet and mild to fiery hot! The town of Szeged is so famous for paprika that it hosts an annual festival celebrating this beloved spice, which has been a cornerstone of Hungarian cuisine for over 400 years.

short_read.title: How Hummingbirds Fly in the Rain
short_read.teaser: Despite their tiny size, hummingbirds have remarkable adaptations that allow them to fly even during rainstorms. Scientists discovered their secret involves special feather structure and incredible mid-air maneuvers.

medium_read.title: The Secret Lives of Orcas in the Salish Sea
medium_read.teaser: The orcas that swim through the Strait of Juan de Fuca have complex family structures and unique dialects passed down through generations. Learn about the three distinct orca populations that call these waters home and the scientists working to protect them.

long_read.title: The Ancient Art of Hungarian Embroidery
long_read.teaser: Hungarian embroidery tells stories through intricate patterns that vary from region to region, each with its own symbolic meanings and traditions. This beautiful craft has been preserved by generations of artisans who continue to stitch their heritage into modern life.

port_angeles.title: Black-Tailed Deer at Hurricane Ridge
port_angeles.description: September is a wonderful time to spot black-tailed deer at Hurricane Ridge, as they're actively feeding before winter. These graceful creatures are often seen grazing in the meadows during early morning or late afternoon, and they're surprisingly comfortable around visitors.

puzzle_1.question: A hummingbird's heart beats approximately ___ times per minute while flying.
puzzle_1.correct_response: That's right! Their tiny hearts work incredibly hard to power those amazing wings!
puzzle_1.close_response: You're very close! The answer is 1,200 beats per minute — that's about 20 times per second!
puzzle_1.wrong_response: It's an amazing 1,200 beats per minute! That tiny heart works incredibly hard to keep those wings humming.
puzzle_1.learn_more_text: To power their hovering flight and rapid wing beats (up to 80 times per second), hummingbirds have the highest metabolism of any animal. They must consume about half their body weight in sugar daily just to survive.

puzzle_2.question: Which Hungarian word means 'hello' or 'goodbye'?
puzzle_2.correct_response: Szia! You got it right! It's one of the most useful words in Hungarian — friendly and casual.
puzzle_2.wrong_response: The answer is 'Szia' (pronounced SEE-ah)! It's a warm, informal way to say both hello and goodbye in Hungarian.
puzzle_2.learn_more_text: Szia is the informal version — for more formal situations, Hungarians say 'Sziasztok' (to multiple people) or 'Jó napot' (good day). The formal goodbye is 'Viszontlátásra,' which literally means 'until I see you again.'

puzzle_3.question: What special ability do harbor seals have that helps them hunt in the dark waters of the Strait of Juan de Fuca?
options: Their whiskers can detect fish movements from several feet away
They have night vision like cats
puzzle_3.correct_response: Wonderful! Harbor seals have incredibly sensitive whiskers that can detect the tiny water movements made by fish, even in complete darkness!
puzzle_3.wrong_response: Their secret is in their whiskers! These sensitive whiskers can detect the tiniest water movements made by fish from several feet away, even in murky or dark water.
puzzle_3.learn_more_text: Each whisker on a harbor seal's face is packed with nerve endings and can move independently. Scientists have found they can track the hydrodynamic trail left by a fish up to 30 seconds after it swam by — like following an underwater scent trail!
